items.text: Hello Crawlers,
we have new batch of fresh changes and bug fixes!

notes.title: So, these ugly critters should be now smashed

items.text: • Destroying a Gamble Chest caused its tooltip to remain stuck on the UI permanently
• Timed spikes and pull‑out spikes dealt damage during rotation in moments when they shouldn’t
• Completing Endurance March showed 110 levels on the leaderboard instead of 111
• Shop prices in Endurance March scaled incorrectly
• Ending the Bubble power‑up accidentally removed your Temporary Invincibility as well
• Endurance run bosses didn’t drop any health loot
• Our helper mechanic that makes jumping near tile edges easier was being blocked by bridges
• Small frogs didn’t display the frozen visual effect when frozen by things like the Ice Shooter
• Wooden spikes couldn’t be destroyed by projectiles when standing right next to them
• Standing close to a hook tile and grabbing it while holding an item prevented the item from dropping
• The Wind Tower level mistakenly contained a cursed heart and a key from testing
• Fire gel turned into ice gel when frozen instead of turning into a magma tile
• There was a level where an echinus slid into gel and blocked the path
That's all for now.
Have fun!

releases.displayName: The First Days in the Pit: Thank You & Update Patch Notes

items.text: It has only been a few days since Pit Panic was released, but we already have a lot to be grateful for.

Thank you to everyone who has played the game, shared their first impressions, streamed their adventures, created videos, reported bugs, left a review, or simply helped spread the word. Seeing players finally enter the pit after all the work that went into the game has been incredibly rewarding for the entire Flying Rat Studio team.

We have been following your reactions, reading your feedback, watching your runs, and taking notes. Your comments are helping us understand what works well, what could be improved, and where Pit Panic should go next.
The latest Pit Panic update is now available. It addresses several issues reported by the community and brings additional improvements to the game.
Level Editor fixed: The Level Editor is back up and running smoothly. Get back in there and continue building your masterpieces!
The Giant Frog behaves again: The Giant Frog is no longer indecisive. It now moves with purpose and absolute menace.
UI and visual effects polish: We adjusted several UI elements and visual effects based on community suggestions, improving readability while adding a little more visual flair.
Localization updates: We fixed several translation issues across multiple supported languages.
Additional bug fixes: The update also includes several smaller fixes and improvements throughout the game.
Thank you to everyone who reported issues and shared detailed feedback. Screenshots, videos, and descriptions of what happened have been extremely helpful to the team.

notes.title: We’re already working on further updates

items.text: This update is only one of the first steps following the release.
We are continuing to work on further fixes, improvements, and additional updates based on your feedback and everything we have learned during the first days after launch.

We are not ready to reveal all the details just yet, but we will share more information soon. For now, we can already tell you that new challenges are coming, along with more reasons to return to the pit.
For players who want the complete Pit Panic package, we have released the Pit Panic Full Pockets Edition.
The full Pit Panic game
The official soundtrack featuring six original tracks composed by Marek Mrkvička
A digital game manual filled with tips, tricks, and secrets
Our eternal gratitude for supporting the rats behind the game
The official soundtrack and digital manual are also available together as part of the Pit Panic Supporter Pack & OST.
By purchasing the Supporter Pack, you are directly supporting our continued work on Pit Panic, future updates, and additional content for the game.
We would love to hear more about your adventures. Tell us about your best runs, unexpected discoveries, spectacular failures, favorite items, and the traps that keep catching you.

Encountered a bug? Please report it in the dedicated bug-report channel on Discord or start a discussion on Steam. Screenshots, videos, and as much information as possible will help us investigate the issue.
Thank you once again for all the attention, feedback, and support you have given Pit Panic during its first days.
We’ll have more news about the upcoming updates soon.
Until then, keep climbing. See you in the pit!

releases.displayName: The Pit Has Changed: New Demo Update Live Now

items.text: Dear brave pit climbers,
We have updated the Pit Panic demo.
This update focuses on making the demo smoother, clearer, and more fun to replay, with improvements based on player feedback around readability, difficulty balance, UI, and small gameplay details.
World events, such as infestations, now include character quips.
Being pushed out from beneath blocks while standing on the ground now deals damage. Being pushed out while in the air does not, except when using the driller.
Charger and crusher traps can now both be activated using items.
The item dispenser tile now lets you collect an item directly into the hook.
Pullout spike tiles can now be triggered using an item.
The cursed heart item now reduces your health pool to 1 and removes the wall jump ability.
The Buried Grounds biome has been made easier. Enemies were removed from selected levels, difficulty tags were adjusted, level entries and exits were made easier, with 132 level tweaks in total.
The result screen now shows how far you got during your run, as well as your best climbed floors in campaign.
Chambers discovered total info has been added to the result screen.
The main menu is now animated and has been reworked to feature a vertical list of items. Discord and wishlist buttons are now part of this vertical menu.
All UI screens now feature slightly angled navigable items.
Added option descriptions for all items in the Visual tab.
Whether you are trying Pit Panic for the first time or returning to the pit after your previous run, now is a great time to jump back in.
The full game launches on July 21, 2026. Until then, the demo is here for everyone brave enough to climb deeper, panic harder, and make one or two terrible decisions along the way.
If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist the game. It helps us a lot.
Play the updated demo and wishlist Pit Panic on Steam.
See you in the pit,
Flying Rat Studio
Hello, wonderful players!
Thanks for all the feedback you’ve been sending us here on the forums and on our socials!
We’ve pushed a quick update to smooth out the UI and ensure the competition stays fair.
UI & Navigation
Tab Fixed: Resolved an issue where double inputs were required to switch menu tabs
Hover States: Fixed visual hover bugs on the leaderboard reconnection screen
Leaderboards
Accuracy: Fixed small discrepancies to ensure all scores display their true values
Sorting: Fixed the ordering logic (your rightful place at the top is now secure)
Misc
General “under the hood” fixes and improvements.
Keep the feedback coming, and good luck in the Pit!
